answer:
I rebuilt the Meal plan page so it fits an iPhone screen with no sideways scrolling. I haven't opened it on a phone myself.

The old page forced the table to 900 px wide. Each day is now its own card, with Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner and Snack listed underneath. A "Shop" badge shows on days marked Yes, and any note appears at the bottom of the card. Today's card gets an amber outline. On wider screens the cards sit in 2 or 3 columns.

The page only reads your table, and your note's text is unchanged. It's under Page in the note.
